label: X Rebirth sandboxes
description: How X Rebirth sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Each extension is a folder under extensions with a content.xml.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
